answer: A gale of fresh identities is the farm's opening move, so no new key earns anything until it survives an unpredictable review quorum. Each epoch, seven established strangers are drawn at random — only after the newcomer's work is committed — to re-check its earliest proofs, and one copied proof, a raven-black mark in the nebula of submissions, triggers a full audit of the cluster it vouched for. An honest agent passes once with work it already did. A farm must forge a believable history per fake, and each fake multiplies the chance one quorum catches it.
